svg.text: Complete 224-Run Multimodal Matrix · Quality Score, AI Credits, Wall Time & Anomalies
Multimodal Fingerprint Matrix: All 28 Models Across All 8 Creative Engineering Tasks
Models ordered by 8-task mean quality; tasks ordered from hardest (3D Scene, med 83.2) to easiest (MP4 Video, med 89.5). Cells show Quality and (credits · time).
Note: ° marks cells where automated checks scored <100%. ⏱ marks cells hitting the 20m (1200s) or 25m timeout. View/tool counts (v/t) track visual self-checks vs. total tool calls.
